# Canvas Game Idea

**Title:** Asteroid Dodge

**Gameplay:** Control a ship at the bottom of the canvas, moving left/right to avoid falling asteroids that spawn randomly and accelerate over time. Optionally fire a single shot to destroy an asteroid.

**Lose Condition:** The game ends when an asteroid collides with the ship or reaches the bottom of the canvas.

<content>
1: // Asteroid Dodge game
2: // Assumes a <canvas id="gameCanvas"></canvas> exists in the HTML
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas element with id "gameCanvas" not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
9:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
10: 
11:   // Ship
12:   const ship = {
13:     width: 40,
14:     height: 20,
15:     x: width / 2 - 20,
16:     y: height - 30,
17:     speed: 5,
18:     color: '#0f0',
19:     draw() {
20:       ctx.fillStyle = this.color;
21:       ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
22:     },
23:     move(dir) {
24:       this.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width - this.width, this.x + dir * this.speed));
25:     },
26:     getRect() {
27:       return {x: this.x, y: this.y, w: this.width, h: this.height};
28:     }
29:   };
30: 
31:   // Bullet (single shot)
32:   const bullet = {
33:     active: false,
34:     x: 0,
35:     y: 0,
36:     speed: 8,
37:     width: 4,
38:     height: 10,
39:     color: '#ff0',
40:     fire() {
41:       if (!this.active) {
42:         this.x = ship.x + ship.width / 2 - this.width / 2;
43:         this.y = ship.y;
44:         this.active = true;
45:       }
46:     },
47:     update() {
48:       if (this.active) {
49:         this.y -= this.speed;
50:         if (this.y + this.height < 0) this.active = false;
51:       }
52:     },
53:     draw() {
54:       if (this.active) {
55:         ctx.fillStyle = this.color;
56:         ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height);
57:       }
58:     },
59:     getRect() {
60:       return {x: this.x, y: this.y, w: this.width, h: this.height};
61:     }
62:   };
63: 
64:   // Asteroids
65:   const asteroids = [];
66:   let asteroidTimer = 0;
67:   const asteroidInterval = 1000; // ms
68:   let lastTime = 0;
69:   let speedFactor = 1; // accelerates over time
70: 
71:   function spawnAsteroid() {
72:     const size = Math.random() * 30 + 20;
73:     const x = Math.random() * (width - size);
74:     asteroids.push({
75:       x,
76:       y: -size,
77:       w: size,
78:       h: size,
79:       speed: 2 * speedFactor + Math.random() * 2,
80:       color: '#f44'
81:     });
82:   }
83: 
84:   function updateAsteroids(dt) {
85:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
86:       const a = asteroids[i];
87:       a.y += a.speed;
88:       // remove off‑screen
89:       if (a.y > height) {
90:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
91:       }
92:     }
93:   }
94: 
95:   function drawAsteroids() {
96:     for (const a of asteroids) {
97:       ctx.fillStyle = a.color;
98:       ctx.beginPath();
99:       ctx.arc(a.x + a.w / 2, a.y + a.h / 2, a.w / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
100:       ctx.fill();
101:     }
102:   }
103: 
104:   function rectsOverlap(r1, r2) {
105:     return !(r1.x + r1.w < r2.x || r1.x > r2.x + r2.w || r1.y + r1.h < r2.y || r1.y > r2.y + r2.h);
106:   }
107: 
108:   function checkCollisions() {
109:     const shipRect = ship.getRect();
110:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
111:       const a = asteroids[i];
112:       const aRect = {x: a.x, y: a.y, w: a.w, h: a.h};
113:       // Ship vs asteroid
114:       if (rectsOverlap(shipRect, aRect)) {
115:         gameOver();
116:         return;
117:       }
118:       // Bullet vs asteroid
119:       if (bullet.active && rectsOverlap(bullet.getRect(), aRect)) {
120:         bullet.active = false;
121:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
122:       }
123:     }
124:   }
125: 
126:   let running = true;
127:   function gameOver() {
128:     running = false;
129:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
130:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
131:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
132:     ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
133:     ctx.textAlign = 'center';
134:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
135:   }
136: 
137:   // Input
138:   const keys = {};
139:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
140:     keys[e.key] = true;
141:     if (e.key === ' ' && running) bullet.fire();
142:   });
143:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
144: 
145:   function loop(timestamp) {
146:     if (!lastTime) lastTime = timestamp;
147:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
148:     lastTime = timestamp;
149: 
150:     if (!running) return;
151: 
152:     // Clear
153:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
154: 
155:     // Move ship
156:     if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a']) ship.move(-1);
157:     if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) ship.move(1);
158: 
159:     // Update bullet
160:     bullet.update();
161: 
162:     // Spawn asteroids
163:     asteroidTimer += dt;
164:     if (asteroidTimer > asteroidInterval) {
165:       spawnAsteroid();
166:       asteroidTimer = 0;
167:       speedFactor += 0.02; // gradual acceleration
168:     }
169: 
170:     // Update and draw asteroids
171:     updateAsteroids(dt);
172:     drawAsteroids();
173: 
174:     // Draw ship and bullet
175:     ship.draw();
176:     bullet.draw();
177: 
178:     // Collisions
179:     checkCollisions();
180: 
181:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
182:   }
183: 
184:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
185: })();

(End of file - total 185 lines)
</content>
